name: KW Solar Solutions, Inc
old_description: Since 2004, KW Solar Solutions, Inc has helped hundreds of customers power their homes through solar energy. We offer photovoltaic (PV) energy systems for homes and other residential properties in Maryland & Delaware
about:
KW Solar Solutions, Inc. was founded in 2004 as a family-owned business in Elkton, Maryland. Dale Wolf, the company’s president and CEO, is an original founder and owner-operator who holds NABCEP certification as both a solar installer and electrician. The firm began with a focus on bringing photovoltaic energy systems to residential customers in the Mid-Atlantic region.

The company designs, installs, and maintains solar photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural clients across Maryland, Delaware, and southern Chester County, Pennsylvania. Its in-house team of master electricians handles every step — custom system design, permitting, utility interconnection agreements, grant applications, and physical installation — without subcontracting. Services also include solar panel repair and replacement, system monitoring, battery backup installation, pest guard fitting, and remove-and-reinstall work for roof replacements.

Customers range from homeowners and small businesses to farms, non-profits, and educational institutions. KW Solar Solutions has completed projects in Cecil and Harford counties in Maryland, New Castle and Kent counties in Delaware, and towns such as Oxford, Avondale, and Kennett Square in Pennsylvania. The company also assists clients with obtaining Renewable Energy Generator certification and selling Solar Renewable Energy Credits (SRECs) through SREC Delaware and SREC Trade.

The firm emphasizes its local roots, 20-plus years of experience, and a full-service model that keeps all work under one roof. It uses American-made panels, inverters, and battery systems, and states that every project meets or exceeds state and county code requirements. Wolf’s NABCEP credentials and the company’s handling of all paperwork and incentive applications are presented as key differentiators.
